title: Cross-domain posting - coastal field survey
purpose: A posting from a completely different job family. It is paired with cross_domain_profile so that the retrieval score for a posting with no relationship to the knowledge base can be read directly: a tailored field carries that score as its evidence, so a score under 0.4 must produce an abstention rather than a draft.
text:
Coastal Field Survey Assistant
Blue Shore Conservation Trust, Singapore

We run quarterly intertidal surveys along the eastern shoreline and we need an
extra pair of hands for the coming season.

What you will do
- carry out transect counts at low tide, following our existing survey protocol
- record substrate and species observations on paper and then type them up
- maintain and clean the survey kit, including the quadrats and the measuring boards
- brief volunteers at the start of each survey day

What we need from you
- willingness to start before sunrise and work in wet conditions
- comfort working in a small team with a fixed protocol
- care with records: an unreadable entry costs us a whole transect
notes: Contains no canonical skill token, so the retrieval query is built from prose alone. The measured score is 0.0 - the raw cosine falls at or under the calibration floor (0.3663) and the rescaling clips it - which is the expected result for a posting with no relationship to the knowledge base.
